newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: ATHLETICS-BOLAND EVENTS SUSPENDED DUE TO FEUD.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-BOLAND EVENTS SUSPENDED DUE TO FEUD.

text.p: Boland athletic events have been suspended in a last-ditch bid to solve the continuing wrangle between two feuding bodies in the association.

Athletics South Africa (ASA) president Leonard Cheune, admitting attempts at a compromise had failed, told a news conference on Friday athletes registered with Boland clubs were barred from all events outside the region and that a moratorium had been placed on meetings in the Boland.
Special dispensation has been given to Boland athletes to compete in South Africa's team for Saturday's international event against Italy in Pretoria.

The complex struggle centres on who runs Boland athletics. Conwall du Plessis was elected as president, but former president Charles Beukes claims to lead the sport and has rejected Supreme Court rulings against him.

Attorney Norman Arendse was last year placed in charge by the National Sports Council (NSC) of a commission of enquiry which will hear evidence from all factions. Their verdict to ASA will be binding.
"These guys are playing games," said NSC chairman Mluleki George. "It's more about egos than anything else. It's painful to see athletes suffer because of officials.
George said he hoped the matter could be resolved in about three weeks.
